claim.scope: Finite matching parent/typed-Dynamic JSON-child shared layouts for existing Compact Object owners: Object wire 4, MAP0/bucket1 or SharedData 1/2/3 with two buckets; ordinary String0/String1, shared String0, MRK3/MRK4, plain/compressed marks, BASIC/COMPACT.
claim.adversary: ROBUST within the executed finite serialization/native oracle and root-reviewed physical ownership/context transport. Same-lineage model review is correlated, not independent replication.
claim.not_claimed: No all-type/layout, arbitrary recursive-product, independent whole-frame/chunk decoder, full-suite, Compact MV/projection, RSS or performance closure.

risk.reason: Persistent serde, selected-child row grids, callback/relocation ownership and a comparator consumed by generic Dynamic physical plans.
risk.strongest_failure: Parent row counts or root Advanced bindings silently substituted for selected JSON-child leaf counts/local callback schedule.
risk.discriminator: Native three-column four-mark fixture with irregular Dynamic actual counts, successive Array sizes, NULL versus empty nested arrays, zero-leaf headers, both buckets and 64-byte frames.
risk.rollback: One atomic W279 local commit over W278; revert only that slice in a clean checkout, preserving unrelated/protected work.

ownership.implementation: Scoped Luna implementation/native instruments, root direct diff review, guarded DoD and composed raw capture verification.
ownership.source_review: Luna pinned-source review; root retained source anchors and independently checked production paths and qualification scope.
ownership.remote: No push or remote history mutation.

source_state.seal_boundary: Ten owned Crystal sources/specs plus three instruments, not a complete-tree/require-graph seal. Docs/index reviewed separately; producer require inputs are additionally pinned before/after in each full matrix.

inherited_string1_and_size_stream_guard.low_cardinality_scope: LowCardinality dictionary and inner serializer use their type default; this does not assert a String1 dictionary stream
inherited_string1_and_size_stream_guard.string_extent_scope: String data bytes use actual logical lengths including zero for empty and embedded NUL bytes; no implicit trailing NUL is part of the String value

guards.scope: setting selects the format family; parsed physical child header is checked only by full helper mode

clickhouse_runtime.distinction: runtime executable SHA/version/build and upstream source revision are pinned independently

outer_guard.policy: Root qualification jobs use one Crystal worker/thread and minimum free memory 50%; monitor process-group RSS, memory/FD/timeouts. Not a hard RLIMIT or a measured RSS/speed certificate.

auditors.boundary: Temporary audit programs/captures are not committed; losing them invalidates raw-audit replay until exact-pin recovery or fresh qualification.

behavior.admitted: Matching sealed SharedData layouts for existing direct typed-Dynamic JSON and bounded Array-chain JSON children; native depths 0/2/3 exercised, depth 1 remains historical W272 coverage.
unchanged_rejections: Root-Dynamic JSON children and further JSON owners beneath the admitted child
Arbitrary outer wrappers/products, mixed parent/child versions, shared layouts, bucket counts or profiles
Advanced shared-path nested Objects and unqualified public typed carriers
Arbitrary-key/append writers and Compact MV/projection integration

count_oracles.boundary: Selected actual, each Array-level vector and JSON-leaf counts are separate; an empty selected Array is not NULL or an absent callback.

production_changes: Sealed parent/child layout comparison instead of MAP-only constants; statistics remain local prefix authority
MRK3 child framing uses selected Dynamic/Array counts and exact local Advanced role schedule
Authenticated child read context retained through Advanced prepared decoding and included in workspace accounting

observed_red.reason: MAP control passes; SharedData 1/2/3 expected-success cases fail at existing layout guard.

useful_failures.reason: Two Advanced read errors reveal dropped authenticated child context.
Existing static MRK3 owner regression reveals missing event context; add exact local registry and regression.

instrumentation_not_production: Depth-three fixture count oracle corrected to [1,0,2,2].
Scratch auditor helper-path and strict full-summary projection adapters repaired, preserving exact path/SHA/key rosters.
Raw active schema contains native whitespace; compare raw tagged rows to independent raw literals and separately bind normalized declared/summary types, not summary-as-raw oracle.
invalid_or_excluded: Older non-final producer canary is not full-pin-qualified.
Agent RLIMIT/ulimit-v attempts are not resource-guard evidence; root reran under normal guard.
Two scratch count-only report-shape probes failed; no aggregate header-observation count is inferred from them.
